plants.name: Monstera Deliciosa 'Albo Borsigiana' — High Variegation
plants.description: Heavy marbled snow-white and emerald sectoral variegation across mature fenestrated leaves. Actively pushing new growth in our custom chunky aroid sanctuary mix.

plants.name: Monstera 'Thai Constellation' — Crème Brûlée Splash
plants.description: High-contrast constellation speckling with large creamy yellow-gold splashes on every leaf. Stable genetics that never revert.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Mint / Ghost' Variegated Collector Specimen
plants.description: Silvery-mint frosted reticulated leaves emerging with ghost-white variegation that deepens to emerald-mint. Grown in our signature chunky bark & perlite blend.

plants.name: Philodendron Pedatum / Oak-Leaf Sanctuary Climber
plants.description: Sculptural deeply-lobed oak-shaped leaves on strong petioles. Photographed next to our studio ruler so you know the exact span.

plants.name: Philodendron 'Billietiae / Long-Leaf' Sanctuary Juvenile
plants.description: Elongated glossy strap-shaped foliage with bright petioles. Tough, fast-growing aroid that commands attention on any plant shelf.

plants.name: Syngonium / Arrowhead Vine — Multi-Node Sanctuary Starter
plants.description: Vigorous multi-node vining specimen with crisp hastate leaves. Perfect for a moss pole or trailing from a top shelf.

merch.name: 'Queen of the Street' Anthurium Warocqueanum Heavyweight Tee
merch.description: Original Magic Walnut street-flash art featuring dual Queen Anthurium strap leaves, gorilla, boombox, skull, and spray can. Designed for Make.com / Printful automated fulfillment.

merch.name: Grower's Notebook Zentangle Queen Anthurium Tee & Tote Art
merch.description: Hand-drawn lined-notebook zentangle Anthurium warocqueanum illustration. Available as a vintage cream tee, canvas plant-haul tote, or studio art print.

merch.name: Lined-Notebook Zentangle Monstera Stool Sketch Tee
merch.description: Intricate patterned Monstera deliciosa perched on a wooden stool over lined notebook paper with street doodle accents.

merch.name: Graphite Botanical Study — Velvet Anthurium & Queen Prints
merch.description: Detailed graphite pencil botanical studies on ruled paper. Every plant order includes a mini collector care-card print!

merch.description: The iconic Magic Walnut bleeding-eye robot watering a Monstera with a broken-heart watering can.
